2026_02_CAR_ATL.headline: Carolina’s depleted interior faces Atlanta’s Bijan-centered backup-quarterback plan
2026_02_CAR_ATL.paragraph1: Atlanta turns to Cooper Rush at quarterback, which makes Bijan Robinson and favorable early downs especially important to the Falcons’ offensive structure. Carolina enters without defensive tackle Bobby Brown III, thinning the interior around Derrick Brown and raising the burden on its run fits. The Panthers need Bryce Young to sustain enough offense to keep Atlanta from dictating tempo; the Falcons need clean protection and manageable down-and-distance so Rush is not repeatedly exposed to obvious passing situations.
2026_02_CAR_ATL.model_rationale: Carolina’s interior run defense and Atlanta’s protection of Rush should shape possession, field position and whether either offense is forced away from its preferred structure.
